data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Erine is a goddess associated with the dawn, the light of the sun, and the healing power of the divine. The name Erine carries the meaning “God's light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erine usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
